title: go.mod marks the directly imported modernc.org/sqlite as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:15 `modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.0 // indirect` while store.go:7 imports it directly; every require in go.mod:5-16 is tagged indirect
suggestion: Run `go mod tidy` so the direct dependency sits in its own require block without the // indirect marker

title: Tests discard json.Unmarshal errors
evidence: main_test.go:41 and main_test.go:80-81 call json.Unmarshal without checking the returned error; a non-JSON body would surface only as a confusing field/length mismatch
suggestion: Check the error and t.Fatal on failure

title: Beyond-spec hardening: body size cap, Location header, negative-year and id validation
